name: Nimrod

abilityDetails.Armor Up: Zırh değerini artırarak alınan fiziksel hasarı azaltır.
abilityDetails.Cowardice: Özel saldırı hasarını belirtilen güçte azaltır.
abilityDetails.Shock: Zamanla elektrik tabanlı şok hasarı verir.
abilityDetails.Energize: Muharebe Güç Oranını belirtilen güçte artırır.
abilityDetails.Energy Vulnerability: Enerji Direncini azaltarak saldırı ve yeteneklerden gelen enerji hasarını artırır.
abilityDetails.Unstoppable: Saldırılar sırasında sersemleme ve geri itilmeye karşı bağışıklık sağlar.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): Çok dayanıklı — doğrudan hasar veya enerji hasarlı (yakma, şok) şampiyon kullan. E1'de tutmak daha güvenli, E2'de durdurulamaz olur. Zırhı kırılamaz ama nötralize edilebilir.
signatureAbility:
Zero Tolerance
During Eradicate Protocol, Special Attacks are Passively Unblockable. Once Eradicate Protocol triggers, Nimrod's next Special Attack has the potency and duration of its effects increased by [9.85 - 35]%.
As an Attacker, against a Mutant, Nimrod gains +1 Armor Up Buff when gaining a personal Armor Up. As a Defender, instead gain +1 Armor Up per Mutant on the Attacker's team.
immunityDetails:
• Kanama Bağışıklığı 🩸
• Zehir Bağışıklığı 🧪
• %100 Zırh Kırma direnci 🛡️
• Yetenek Doğruluğu Azaltma Bağışıklığı 🧠❇️

abilitySections.title: As a Defender
content: When the Opponent fills a Bar of Power, inflict a Special Lock Passive for 1.50 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Superior Mutant Hunting Robot
content: Advanced Robotics provides Immunity to Bleed & Poison effects.
Incoming Armor Breaks cannot remove Nimrod's Armor Ups and suffer 100% reduced potency.
Attacks deal Energy Damage instead of Physical.
Against Mutants, gain Immunity to Ability Accuracy Modification.

abilitySections.title: Adaptive Protocols
content: Nimrod starts each fight in TITAN Protocol, and can swap to BLITZ Protocol. Swap Protocols every 11 seconds or when landing a 4th Light Attack.
At the start of each fight, and when the Protocol timer expires naturally, gain 1 Armor Up Buff. All personal Armor Ups grant +[687.5] Armor Rating for 20 seconds.
Gain 1 Protocol Charge for each TITAN or BLITZ effect gained or inflicted during Nimrod's Special Attacks.
Gain 1 Protocol Charge when gaining an Armor Up effect, or when the Opponent gains a Prowess or Regeneration effect.
At 10 Protocol Charges, activate a Special Attack to launch ERADICATE Protocol for 16 seconds, combining the effects of both TITAN and BLITZ Protocols.

abilitySections.title: Titan Protocol
content: Reduce the damage of incoming Critical Hits by 20%. This potency is increased by 25% per active Armor Up effect.
When the Opponent activates a Special Attack, inflict a 40% Cowardice Debuff for 15 seconds.
Well-Timed Blocks grant 1 personal Armor Up Buff.

abilitySections.title: BLITZ Protocol
content: Attacks gain +[4,028.4] Attack Rating. This potency is increased by 25% per active Armor Up effect.
When the Opponent activates a Special Attack, inflict Power Drain Debuff, draining 150% of a Bar of Power over 15 seconds.
Attacks Invalidate 1 Prowess and remove 1 Regeneration effect, replacing each with a Shock Debuff dealing [2,014.2] Energy Damage over 1.50 seconds. This can trigger through Block.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: TITAN: Gain a non-stacking 54% Energize Buff for 25 seconds.
BLITZ: On hit, inflict a non-stacking [1,480.77] Energy Vulnerability Passive for 25 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: TITAN: Gain an Unstoppable Buff for 5 seconds, paused until the Special Attack ends.
BLITZ: Each hit inflicts a Shock Passive, dealing [18,631.35] Energy Damage over 2 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: TITAN: Gain non-stacking Self-Repair Passive healing 12.5% of missing Health over 15 seconds. This Self-Repair is lost if Nimrod is Stunned.
BLITZ: Deal a burst of up to [120,852] Energy Damage based on the Opponent's missing Health.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Zero Tolerance
content: During Eradicate Protocol, Special Attacks are Passively Unblockable. Once Eradicate Protocol triggers, Nimrod's next Special Attack has the potency and duration of its effects increased by [9.85 - 35]%.
As an Attacker, against a Mutant, Nimrod gains +1 Armor Up Buff when gaining a personal Armor Up. As a Defender, instead gain +1 Armor Up per Mutant on the Attacker's team.
